effect_of_absence: UNKNOWN; no demand value, priority, revenue, public mutation, or zero may be inferred.

sources.why_needed: Aggregate breadth, competition band and bid band can corroborate an existing canonical family; they are not revenue or causal priority.
sources.authorized_access: Google Ads account UI/export only; no scraping, auth bypass or API credential request.
sources.exact_export: Keyword Planner > Discover new keywords or Get search volume and forecasts > export historical metrics for Brazil, Portuguese, last 12 complete months.
sources.sanitization: Aggregate only to a pre-existing canonical family_id; replace numeric volume and bid with LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH bands; delete every raw row and identifier before creating the JSON draft.

sources.why_needed: Relative momentum, seasonality and Brazilian geography can corroborate an existing canonical family; the index is never absolute volume.
sources.authorized_access: Official Google Trends UI export/API legitimately available to the founder; no unofficial scraper or rate-limit bypass.
sources.exact_export: Explore > Brazil > past 12 months > Web Search > export interest over time and regional interest, then aggregate to existing family_id.
sources.sanitization: Retain only RISING/STABLE/FALLING and BRA; do not retain search terms, numeric indices, related-query text or export rows.

sources.why_needed: A bounded manual observation can corroborate language, intent and result format for an existing canonical family; it is never volume or durable rank.
sources.authorized_access: Normal browser observation only; do not use a persistent crawler, automation, login bypass, or rate-limit bypass.
sources.exact_export: No export is required. Record a human-reviewed, date-stamped aggregate classification for Brazil/Portuguese from a bounded manual SERP/PAA/related/autocomplete observation, then discard source text and URLs.
sources.sanitization: Keep only HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW intent and a controlled format label such as service, guide, calculator, or official_source; retain no result text, URL, domain, rank, screenshot, or query string.

ingestion.draft_location: a local, access-controlled file outside git until sanitized; then data/demand_radar/intake-candidates/YYYY-MM-DD/<source>.draft.json for review
ingestion.normalize_command: python3 -m scripts.demand_radar.external_intake normalize --as-of YYYY-MM-DD --input DRAFT --output SNAPSHOT
ingestion.expected_checksum: The command prints deterministic SHA-256 snapshot_sha256; copy that exact value into the reviewed approved-sources.v1.json entry, then run verify.
ingestion.revoke: Remove the exact approval and snapshot in one reviewed change, rebuild the existing Radar, and the source becomes UNKNOWN.
